(1)(c) MEDICAL CASE MANAGEMENT – Medical Case Management is an optional service provided by the URO for certain patients with serious and costly illnesses. The objective is to coordinate and monitor patient care and promote the earliest, maximum recovery or rehabilitation. Before URO is offered the Company reviews the case (on a confidential basis) and approves the service. The Company can discontinue the service at any time. The patient must agree to the offer of service and may discontinue use at any time.
